  {"step":10,"file":"src-vul/libidn2/lib/idna.c","function":"_idn2_u8_to_u32_nfc","line":92,"var":"tmp","code":"uint32_t *tmp = u32_normalize (UNINORM_NFC, p, plen, NULL, &tmplen);","note":"If the label is not already NFC, it is normalized into a new UTF-32 buffer before punycode encoding."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src-vul/libpsl/src/psl.c","function":"psl_idna_toASCII","line":780,"var":"lookupname","code":"if (domain_to_punycode(utf8, lookupname, sizeof(lookupname)) == 0) { ... }","note":"The converted label is copied into a fixed-size stack buffer for punycode output; an oversized or malformed conversion can overflow this sink in the vulnerable build."}
